post_remediation.note: No single- or paired-dimension perturbation within the searched realistic range evaded this policy - this pattern is robustly caught.

method: Starting from attack_coverage.py's BASE_PATTERN (a known-abuse fixed point every dimension sweep already knows this policy currently catches), a fine grid search (400 points per axis, 45x45 per pair) finds the smallest normalized perturbation - single-axis or two-axis combined - that flips the policy's prediction from caught (1) to evaded (0). Distance is normalized per dimension by its realistic sweep range so units (rupees, days, a 0-3 sharing count) are comparable; a 2-axis distance is Euclidean over the two normalized deltas.
